value.rationale: PASS. The natural dissipative star has a continuum of equilibria whose individual dynamics are selected by conserved compositions. A sharp iff criterion for coexistence of two distinct spectral relaxation types for the same fixed model coefficients, together with a computable basin divider and asymptotic oscillation clock, is a useful structural result even though its constituent linearization and LaSalle methods are standard. It is more than a generic stability exercise.

limitations: All state variables and coefficients strictly positive; repeated-eigenvalue critical case not classified.
General Lyapunov/LaSalle and planar-stability lemmas are standard; finite numerical examples are not all-time proofs.
